As an AI, I can process and understand text in a wide variety of languages. However, my ability to "read" in the traditional human sense is not the same. I can comprehend and generate text in over 100 languages, including but not limited to:

- English
- Spanish
- French
- German
- Italian
- Portuguese
- Russian
- Chinese (Simplified and Traditional)
- Japanese
- Korean
- Arabic
- Dutch
- Swedish
- Danish
- Norwegian
- Finnish
- Polish
- Turkish
- Greek
- Hindi
- Urdu
- Persian
- Czech
- Hungarian
- Bulgarian
- Romanian
- Vietnamese
- Thai
- Indonesian
- Malay

If you have a specific language in mind, feel free to ask, and I can try to help you with it!
